subject: My fav boost has to be stunt
author: YBMASTER
body: My fav boost has to be stunt and then burnout 2 speed boost

subject: The Ultimate Boost!
author: ZombieTron
body:
I agree 100% 🙂 The Boost from Burnout Dominator is the best of both worlds. Although I liked the idea of earning boost in the first 2 games, and the way that was executed made it feel really worthwhile. I don't think they quite have the feel of earning boost right in Paradise? dunno why, I think it just feels a bit too in the background.  And once they gave us always on boost in Burnout 3: Takedown there was really no going back for me. I am a lazy gamer, if I don't have to earn a full boost bar to be able to use boost, I will be very happy!

So, Dominator lets you use boost the second you get any, but if you can be that little bit patient and work at it to fill your bar, the rewards are great! And I love the graphics of it, that it turns blue when you can boost chain, simple and effective!

In Paradise I prefer Stunt Boost, but I love Speed Boost too, especially for timed road rules. I never use Aggression Boost and still don't really see the point of it.  I hope they introduce Dominator style boost in GCC. 🤓
